verdict.rationale: Jan's README lists Custom Assistants for creating 'specialized AI assistants for your tasks.' The assistants docs show task-specific instructions, such as a Python/JavaScript mentor persona, and an assistant can be assigned to a project so every conversation there uses that persona and instructions. missing for 10: documentation of per-assistant settings beyond instructions (model choice, parameters, tool/MCP scoping), independent or hands-on corroboration.
